item.title: The Pentagon's Missing Blueprint for Munitions Sovereignty
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
The U.S. military is burning through critical missile stockpiles faster than it can build them—and a scathing new GAO report reveals that managing the crisis is literally no one's job.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Decades-long production timelines for complex assets like Patriot interceptors clash with the high-consumption realities of modern asymmetric warfare. [SPLIT] ⚡ Decentralized inventory tracking across individual military services creates massive blind spots and prevents comprehensive department-wide oversight. item.title: When Uniforms Clash: The Jorhat Traffic Incident and Civil-Military Friction
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A routine traffic stop in Assam's Jorhat district escalated into a civil-military flashpoint after an MVI issued a challan to an Army driver, exposing underlying jurisdictional friction.
[SPLIT] ⚡ District Transport Officer Dhananjay Saikia clarified that the fine was strictly for a seatbelt violation, debunking social media rumors regarding license invalidity. [SPLIT] ⚡ The incident underscores distinct legal frameworks governing civilian and military driving credentials, where military licenses do not automatically extend to non-tactical private vehicles. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/when-uniforms-clash-the-jorhat-traffic-incident-and-civil-military-friction-210916.html
